label: Course Builder
description: Turn any local markdown knowledge repository into an OpenMAIC course-source document. Point it at a directory, index it once with the local embed model, then generate a grounded .md from a prompt — ready to upload into OpenMAIC.
notes: This rail owns its own React UI (not an iframe). The backend runs the full RAG pipeline: chunking, embedding via the broker's @embed role, cosine retrieval, and optional LLM condensation. No companion container.
The index is a DuckDB file kept on the host, outside OneDrive (CB_INDEX_PATH, default ~/.course-builder-index.duckdb). It is large and churning — not a repo artifact.

Blueprints (exam domain outlines) come from a CSV pointed at by CB_BLUEPRINT_CSV. Point this at ai-notes/research/blueprint-domains.csv or any CSV with credential_code/domain_name/weight_percent/sub_skill columns.
Indexing and building run in a ThreadPoolExecutor because DuckDB and numpy are synchronous. Progress streams to the browser via SSE.
